Episode 254. The Egos of the Sun God (2)
June 13, 1804, The Tower of Stories.
The dawn was deepening. Kelliark Zipple organized his throbbing head and looked back on the recent situation.
There had been too many changes, too suddenly.
The truth of the multiple worlds, the Demon Army, an ever-strengthening enemy, and even the recent negotiation with Lokia that was closer to a threat.
Naturally.

Kelliark still felt no sense of belonging to the 'unified Zipple'. Of course, it was true that he had strengthened the Origin Stone with their support and overcome several crises, but according to Lokia's explanation, the unified Zipple was less an ally and more a superior that could turn hostile at any moment.

-Yes, don't make any mistakes. If either of us messes up, the Demon Army will wipe this entire world away. And, under no circumstances should you meet Kelliark of the unified Zipple in person. You'd be devoured instantly. He only shares the same name as you, he's a monster on a different level.

'Of course, I can't trust everything Lokia says... but there's not much to doubt either. At this rate, we will soon be reduced to minions that the unified Zipple can use and discard. To think I've already fallen to hell and hit rock bottom once, only to end up in this state again.'
Just thinking about it left a bitter taste in his mouth.

The current Zipple was, excluding a thousand years ago, practically the strongest it had ever been. Yet even with that power, he was failing to seize hegemony, and even that was merely the hegemony of a single world.
“Kelliark, my friend, is something wrong?”
“Yes, it's nothing but unpleasant matters.”
Ragal shrugged and cautiously watched Kelliark's expression. Seeing the man who had even controlled Zito at will reveal such a troubled state made him feel as if his own mind was becoming disordered.

“There is no breakthrough in any direction. Facing the Vamel Alliance without the support of the Demon Army is not an easy task, and what's more, it's impossible to even attempt. If we don't follow the Demon Army’s command, we will be disposed of. I didn't know we would become this precarious so suddenly.”
“Those things called the Demon Army... are they really that strong?”
“Their power was already proven the moment they strengthened our Origin Stone. They just can't reveal it all because of the restrictions on interdimensional interference.”

“Tsk, and it's because they can't overcome that interference that things are going awry. If those bastards had provided support on time every time, two more egos of the Sun God wouldn't have fallen into the hands of the Vamel Alliance, would they?”
Following Bliggiet, even Beltian and Nepdol.
The Tower of Stories was also aware of the fact that all those egos had fallen into the grasp of the Vamel Alliance. They just lacked the capacity to properly stop it.
“The Vamel Alliance will utilize the egos of the Sun God in some way. Just as we are using Elona now.”
Elona Zipple.
She, who held the power of the ego of destruction, Malugia, was now practically the only means by which the Zipple could rebound on their own.

“That's likely. According to the Origin Stone's calculations, Beltian can become some kind of power source. It said that once the ship that uses him as a power source is completed, it will become much harder to evade their pursuit than it is now.”
It was truly a case of being besieged on all sides.

If one were to add one more factor for a rebound in addition to Elona, it would be the case of Jin falling to demonic transformation due to the continued massacres of civilians, but that too seemed unlikely to be realized.
“What do you think, Ragal.”
“About what?”
“I mean, what should we do.”

“Oh... Kelliark my friend, are you finally acknowledging me as an advisor! Then I shall answer. In my opinion... hmm, first of all, you're right about everything. We're screwed. Lokia and the Vamel Alliance are one thing, but the Demon Army is the biggest problem. It's a problem if we become independent from them, and a problem if we don't.”
Ragal imitated Kelliark and filled his and Kelliark's teacups.

“Lokia and the Vamel Alliance are at least visible enemies, and one is threatening us with the Origin Stone while the other feels slightly ahead of us... but the Demon Army is not like that. Those things are just a great, unknown existence. In that case, wouldn't it be best to first remove the Demon Army from this fight?”
“...You want to take care of the Demon Army?”

“Yes. It seems like an answer will only come once we exclude them from this battlefield. Anyway, when you decided to seize hegemony again from the depths of hell, you never had the support of the Demon Army in mind, did you, Kelliark my friend?”
Kelliark nodded. He too, of course, had only recently learned the truth of the multiple worlds.

“So, first, we exclude the Demon Army, and it makes for a better picture for the people of this world to be fighting amongst themselves. If we do that, the problem of us being disposed of at any moment disappears, doesn't it? Even if we may fall while fighting the enemy.”
“I wasn't expecting much, but that is a strangely refreshing answer. But what is the method to stop the interference of the Demon Army?”
“Haha, that I do not know.”
After a moment of silence, Ragal cleared his throat and looked at Kelliark.

“But wouldn't a method emerge if we calculate it with the Origin Stone? In the first place, it's certain that interdimensional interference has immense restrictions, so even if our forces are relatively weaker than the Demon Army, I think we could sufficiently wear them down.”
The moment he said that.
Kelliark and Ragal suddenly felt a vibration. The flying Tower of Stories was shaking like a ship caught in a typhoon.
“An enemy attack!? There was no reaction from the Origin Stone?”
Ragal jumped up in surprise and checked the Demon God's Stone. Kelliark also went down to the central part of the tower with him and checked the state of the stone.
“Elona Zipple! What's wrong with you?”
As soon as the two arrived at the central part, they could observe Elona's appearance changing.

Elona's hair was long to begin with, but this was on another level. Her hair, shining entirely in gold, was completely covering the central part of the tower like the roots of a great tree exposed above the ground.

The tree form at the bottom of the Origin Stone was also entwined in her hair, to the point where it looked like a golden pillar, and there was only one thing in the central part that was not dyed in gold.

Only the pupils of Elona Zipple, in which the universe seemed to flow, were sparkling with various colors and stood out. The moment they met her gaze, Kelliark and Ragal were able to realize it at the same time.
“Malugia...!”
The fact that the one awakening her now was not Elona, but the ego of Malugia.
And that power was so immense that even Kelliark could not dare to control it, and all the restraining structures prepared to fuse her with the Origin Stone were useless.
A cold sweat ran down his back.
If she put her mind to it, it seemed that Malugia could, right now, finish off not only the two people in front of her but also the Tower of Stories itself.
'Was Bluggiet's word... true. That Malugia was just letting herself be captured by us.'
Letting herself be captured.
Facing the sun energy being emitted now, he had no choice but to think so.
“Kelliark my friend, what in the world. W-what do we do!? Should we... run? Uh, uh, friend!”
While Ragal was shouting, Kelliark was striding towards Malugia.

“Since the likes of Bligiet promised to protect us from you, this is a moment where I don't feel so sorry for betraying him. For what purpose have you finally revealed your true form for the first time, Malugia?”
Kelliark said in a calm voice.
If she had intended to kill him anyway, she already had more than enough power to do so. It was grounds for him to be certain that she had some special purpose.
[Kelliark Zipple.]
“Kuaaak...!”
The moment Malugia's voice echoed, Ragal let out a scream and, without realizing it, collapsed to his seat.
A horrific pressure that he had never felt even from Zito during his time in the Demon World was crushing Ragal's entire body.
'She's on a completely different level from the egos of the Sun God we've seen or been reported on so far...!'
Kelliark also endured the head-splitting pressure and faced Malugia.
[You are bold. You know that I will not kill you.]
“Aren't you also established here because you need me? So how about you stop trying to scare me.”
Malugia looked down at Kelliark for a while, as if intrigued.

[It is a truly strange thing. That a weak being like you seeks to rule this world... However, I too am trapped in a contradiction. Though I have the power to turn you to ash in an instant, I need your hand.]

“State what you want. Ego of Destruction, Malugia, do you merely wish for the destruction of all, as your name suggests? If my family and I cannot become the sole hegemon of this world, then I will gladly play along with that as well.”
[First, there is a need to close the numerous worlds that have branched off from you. Those numerous dregs that were created when you manipulated history a thousand years ago.]
Malugia's objective was, literally, the ultimate ruin.
To her, the Demon Army of the multiple worlds was a great obstacle. Because even if she destroyed this entire world, if a 'world' remained in some other dimension, it would not be the end.

“Numerous dimensions were created when we manipulated history a thousand years ago... that must have been a very unpleasant matter for you. The world that you, who were whole, created with such difficulty, we created countless versions of it by merely revising a few lines in a history book.”
[In those numerous dimensions, I was sealed and used multiple times, so it was a very impertinent matter.]
“Keuk...!”
Suddenly, Kelliark grabbed his own neck.
When Malugia gestured, a pain as if his neck was being severed erupted, and blood flowed. However, only the skin of his neck was torn; it was not cut deep enough to fall off.
Sun energy seeped into the wound, and the injury healed in an instant. The scar that remained on his neck was Malugia's imprint.
Kelliark's life was now Malugia's.
[That is the price for your unrestrained words. From now on, I will go to find another self of mine, Kragos. After I awaken him, I will fall asleep again.]
“After you awaken Kragos, what should I do?”
[Do whatever you wish. For I have chosen you.]
“That is a truly pleasing answer...”

[You need only keep one thing in mind. That in the end, what awaits you all is only the apocalypse. In the end, everyone will die and disappear, and not even a trace will remain. Not even a single speck of dust blowing in the wind.]
